description: This file manages user messages and notifications within the Notesnook mobile app, including prompts for app rating, recovery key, login, email verification, and app updates. It imports various services and components to handle message display and user interactions.

methods.name: showMessageById
methods.description: Sets a message in the message store based on the provided message ID.

methods.name: setRateAppMessage
methods.description: Displays the 'rate app' message to the user.

methods.name: setRecoveryKeyMessage
methods.description: Displays the 'recovery key' message to the user.

methods.name: setLoginMessage
methods.description: Displays the 'login' message to the user.

methods.name: setEmailVerifyMessage
methods.description: Displays the 'email verification' message to the user.

methods.name: setUpdateAvailableMessage
methods.description: Displays an update available message with version info.
